protocols.name: Resumable resolve
protocols.algorithm: Load inbox/resolved_<date>.json if present; todo = to_resolve items whose norm_key is not yet a key; 4 worker threads; results merged in order and the whole file re-dumped every 20 songs and at the end. The agent loops 'timeout 160 ... resolve' until the final line appears.

protocols.name: Ledger save and snapshot

protocols.conflict_resolution: last writer wins; no lock or version check

protocols.name: TIDAL crate reconcile
protocols.algorithm: Desired = every active crate's tidal ids sorted by energy then BPM; playlists in tidal_playlists.json without 'set:' prefix and no longer a crate are emptied. For each: create if missing (Idempotency-Key uuid5('create:'+name)), list items, remove extras, add missing in chunks of 50 (onDuplicates SKIP, key uuid5(add:pid:date:name:n:i)). Then writes sync_result and runs confirm.
protocols.conflict_resolution: ledger is the source of truth; TIDAL order is not enforced for crates
protocols.stale_fallback: no user token: step skipped; TidalError: ALERT_tidal.txt and partial results

protocols.name: Saved set to TIDAL

protocols.conflict_resolution: page copy wins (full replace)

protocols.name: Artifact saved-set mirror

protocols.conflict_resolution: shared copy wins by id at load; local deletions made while the store was unreachable are never replayed

protocols.name: library.json to songnodes
protocols.algorithm: POST body = file bytes, Idempotency-Key 'import-'+md5(file); enqueue library_ingest job; worker maps short keys, upserts tracks, writes library.track_xref(source_id -> canonical uuid), appearances, rotation_history, then queues projections and enrichment backfill. The songnodes script polls /api/v1/jobs/<id> and retries a dead job; run_weekly does not poll.

protocols.stale_fallback: run_weekly prints a note on failure and carries on

protocols.name: TIDAL PKCE login through the songnodes app

protocols.name: Durable job queue (ingestion_jobs)
protocols.algorithm: enqueue INSERT ON CONFLICT (kind,idempotency_key) DO NOTHING returning the original row; claim_next first dead-letters expired leases with no attempts left, then selects queued (run_after<=now) or lease-expired running rows FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED and increments attempts; handler and follow-up enqueues and complete run in one transaction; failure -> fail() requeues with backoff 30s*2^(attempts-1) capped 3600s (x4 for transient), dead when attempts>=max_attempts or permanent 4xx (except 408/429).
protocols.conflict_resolution: idempotency key returns existing job; SKIP LOCKED prevents double claim; lease reclaim for crashed workers
protocols.stale_fallback: dead jobs revived by POST /api/v1/jobs/{id}/retry; succeeded pruned after 14 days

protocols.name: Recurring jobs via time-bucketed keys
protocols.algorithm: songnodes.schedule every 30s enqueues projection_consume, graph_projection_consume (15s buckets), ingest_pending (60s), scrape_targets (3600s), audio_analysis (600s) with key tick:{kind}:{now//interval}.
protocols.conflict_resolution: overlapping beats collide on the same key

protocols.name: Transactional outbox to projections
protocols.algorithm: append in the writer transaction; consumers read (txid,id) > offset and txid < pg_snapshot_xmin; handler + advance in one transaction; 3 attempts then outbox_dead_letters and advance; rebase_after_restore resets txids after dump/restore.
protocols.conflict_resolution: keyed upserts, at-least-once

protocols.name: Library ingest idempotency
protocols.algorithm: script computes md5 of library.json -> Idempotency-Key import-<md5>; POST /api/v1/library/ingest enqueues library_ingest; script polls GET /api/v1/jobs/{id} and retries dead once; worker processes payload in one transaction and enqueues projection/backfill follow-ups.
protocols.conflict_resolution: same key returns the original job regardless of body (contract promises 409 for a different body: not implemented)

protocols.name: Scrape -> ingest -> projection ordering
protocols.algorithm: scrape handler (sync HTTP) -> follow-up ingest_pending keyed by job -> if changed, projection_consume, graph_projection_consume, enrichment_backfill; ingest_pending chains itself while examined>=limit; independent 60s tick also runs ingest_pending.
protocols.conflict_resolution: ingest_playlist locks bronze and silver playlist rows FOR UPDATE; INGEST_MARKER prevents re-ingest
protocols.stale_fallback: 60s tick catches anything a follow-up missed

protocols.name: Scheduled-scrape window

protocols.name: Saved sets server/device merge

debt.detail: Ledger, resolved_<date>.json and sync_result_<date>.json are whole-file rewrites; the Beatport playbook writes the same date-keyed files the weekly run owns.

debt.title: SQLite swap is a copy, not an atomic rename

debt.title: Artifact bundle cannot be rebuilt from songnodes main
debt.detail: SetBuilderPage now imports readSavedSetsAsync and writeSavedSetsAsync and loads from /api/v1/library/search; artifact-data.ts exports neither, and the copy-patch text changed. Published app.js is the 24 Oct build on design system 1.1.0 (songnodes now 1.10.0).

debt.title: Legacy artifact/index.html breaks the design system
debt.detail: 48 hex colours, 181 px values, own Google fonts and tokens, 0 sn- classes; README still calls it the page source. The published build (app.js) has 0 hex and uses songnodes tokens.

debt.title: Build shell has no charset
debt.detail: artifact/build/index.html has no <meta charset>; rendered outside the claude.ai wrapper the middle dot and apostrophes become mojibake (M3: 'Â·'). Fine only while the platform wrapper adds a charset.

debt.title: std_crate_cap is configured but never enforced
debt.detail: rules.rotation.std_crate_cap=250 has no reader; only high_crate_cap is applied.

debt.title: songnodes ingest and setlist posts swallow errors
debt.detail: cmd_sync_songnodes prints a 'note' on ingest failure and 'except Exception: pass' on setlists; it never polls the job, unlike import-music-library.sh.

debt.title: TIDAL tokens and ref_mb passwords are plain files on a synced drive
debt.detail: secrets/*.json and ref_mb/secrets/*.txt; ref_mb/.gitignore covers secrets but musicLibrary has no git; deletes are blocked on the synced drive so pending PKCE files are blanked, not removed.

debt.title: Run cadence does not match the documented schedule
debt.detail: Documented Sunday 7:37am; outputs exist for 24 Oct, 27 Oct, 31 Oct and 3 Nov (none on a Sunday), so the 8-day window overlaps and ARIA weeks are re-counted.

debt.title: Unified scraper writes silver tables directly, bypassing datalayer ingest
debt.detail: PersistencePipeline maps tracks/playlists/playlist_tracks batches to silver_enriched_* and inserts with no ON CONFLICT on tracks, defaults artist to Unknown Artist and appends no outbox event. datalayer ingest_pending then creates its own silver rows for the same bronze playlist (lookup-then-insert, no unique key), so duplicates and Unknown Artist rows are possible and projection_tracks never hears of the scraper rows. Violates CLAUDE.md "no layer skipping" and artist attribution.

debt.title: Gold and operational layers do not exist in the running stack
debt.detail: CLAUDE.md describes Bronze -> Silver -> Gold -> Operational; compose applies no gold migration (003) and runs no gold ETL; gold_track_graph is created but never read or refreshed; graph-api reads silver directly. Operational is effectively projection_tracks (library search) and silver reads.

debt.title: 1001tracklists daily Redis quota blocks hourly target scrapes
debt.detail: scrape_targets enqueues a 1001tracklists job per target each hour; the 1001tracklists spider does not set force_run for search_query (MixesDB does), so after the first run in 24 h enforce_run_quota raises CloseSpider(daily_quota_reached), the job succeeds with found_nothing and the target is stamped last_searched for 7 days.

debt.title: Scrape handler holds a DB transaction open for up to 16 minutes
debt.detail: runner.run_one wraps the handler in conn.transaction(); the scrape handler awaits a synchronous POST /scrape (timeout 960s) inside it, leaving an idle-in-transaction session and blocking pg_snapshot_xmin, which also stalls outbox consumers (events from newer transactions stay invisible while this xmin is held).

debt.title: Two worker processes shared by 15-minute scrapes and 15-second projections
debt.detail: Worker runs --concurrency=2 with beat in-process; two queued scrapes occupy both processes and projection/ingest ticks wait (their Celery tasks expire after 15s).

debt.title: API token middleware reads Authorization Bearer before X-API-Token
debt.detail: TIDAL routes require Authorization: Bearer <tidal token>; when SONGNODES_API_TOKEN is set the middleware takes the TIDAL token as the API token and returns 401 even with a valid X-API-Token. SENSITIVE_GET_PREFIXES lists /api-keys but the route is /api/v1/api-keys, so GET of saved keys stays open.

debt.title: Write and admin REST routes open in compose
debt.detail: SONGNODES_API_TOKEN is not passed in compose.dev.yaml, so register_security returns without a middleware. Port bound to 127.0.0.1 limits exposure to the laptop.

debt.title: Saved API keys encrypted with a hard-coded default key
debt.detail: API_KEY_ENCRYPTION_SECRET is not set for rest-api or worker; store_api_key falls back to a hard-coded default key committed in the SQL file (value not reproduced here). OAuth tokens are plain text by design.

debt.title: graph_projection consumer runs every 15 s against a store that does not exist
debt.detail: No memgraph service or MEMGRAPH_URI in compose; handle_event returns immediately but offsets advance, so enabling Memgraph later needs a rebuild.

debt.title: Tables written but never read, or read but never written
debt.detail: web_call_log (written, no reader); gold_track_graph (created, no reader); musicdb.user_setlists (written by graph-api, no reader, schema absent); song_adjacency (written by scraper, table absent); bronze_api_enrichments (neither); target_track_searches (CLAUDE.md says scraper reads it; only legacy SQL writes it); library.set.saved.v1 and setlist ingested/rejected outbox events have no consumer.

debt.title: projection_tracks consumer ignores library_track events
debt.detail: import_library emits library.track.upserted.v1 / rotation_changed.v1 with aggregate_type library_track; projection.handle_event handles only track and artist, so library search reads stale projection rows until reconcile/rebuild. graph_projection does handle library_track.

debt.title: Duplicate /api/graph/nodes and /api/graph/edges in rest-api are unreachable
debt.detail: nginx sends ^/api/graph to graph-api, so rest-api main.py versions never receive frontend traffic; two implementations can diverge.

debt.title: Job stages poll in-memory scraper progress
debt.detail: Frontend polls GET /api/v1/jobs/{id}/stages, which polls GET /scrape/progress/{job_id} with a 2s timeout; progress lives in process memory and is lost on scraper restart.

debt.title: CLAUDE.md contracts disagree with code
debt.detail: Unified scraper body is {source, search_query, ...} not {spider_name, search_params}; transitions columns are from_track_id/to_track_id not source/target; bronze uses raw_json/scraped_at not raw_metadata; target_tracks not target_track_searches; enrichment does not delegate to metadata-enrichment:8020 (8020 is audio-analysis); Discogs env is DISCOGS_TOKEN in worker and DISCOGS_API_TOKEN for the scraper, which reads DISCOGS_TOKEN.

debt.title: No migration ledger in compose; start-dev.sh is the list
debt.detail: Migrations run by hand-maintained psql lines with ad-hoc sentinels; 000 schema_migrations, 003-005/007-008 medallion, 001-011 and 250 are not applied; worker migrate.py only knows 012-014.

debt.title: Backup scripts target names that do not exist
debt.detail: scripts/backup_database.sh dumps -U musicdb_user musicdb; backup_volumes.sh tars songnodes_postgres_data etc. The compose project uses user/db songnodes and volume songnodes-dev_dev-postgres-18. Only the CLAUDE.md one-liner works.

debt.detail: Contract: same key + different body -> 409, and per-row results in the response. Code: jobs.enqueue returns the original job for any body and the endpoint returns only {job_id,status,created}. GET /api/v1/library/tracks/{id} is documented but only /preview exists.

debt.title: Deleting a saved set emits no outbox event
debt.detail: save_set appends library.set.saved.v1; delete_set does not, so any projection of sets cannot remove it.

debt.title: Two saved-setlist stores
debt.detail: graph-api POST /api/user-setlists (musicdb.user_setlists) and rest-api library.sets coexist; only library.sets has a reader.

debt.detail: No register(app) and not included by main.py; router_registry skips it by AST check. Its routes are also commented out.

debt.detail: PR #577 exposes the frontend (which proxies all /api/ to rest-api and graph-api) publicly; rest-api has no auth middleware on main (SONGNODES_API_TOKEN unset) and PR #578 adds a login router without any middleware gating other routes. debt.detail: PR #580 changes rest-api main.py /api/graph/nodes and /api/graph/edges error details; nginx sends /api/graph to graph-api, so those handlers are shadowed. The music-search change is effective.

debt.title: already_linked check scans transitions with LIKE on jsonb text
debt.detail: Re-ingest of an existing playlist runs playlist_occurrences::text LIKE %id% across silver_track_transitions (no index), cost grows with the graph.

debt.detail: songnodes-store partialize persists musicCredentials (access/refresh tokens, clientId/clientSecret); window.debugZustand.getMusicCredentials and injectTestCredentials ship in production builds. OAuthCallback deliberately moved tokens to sessionStorage, so the two disagree.

debt.title: Unreachable modules still carrying endpoints

debt.detail: nginx sends /api/(graph|v1/visualization|user-setlists) to graph-api; Vite sends only /api/graph and /api/v1/graph (rewritten) to 8084, so /api/v1/visualization and /api/user-setlists hit rest-api in dev. rest-api also defines /api/graph/nodes and /api/graph/edges that nginx never reaches.

Design-system docs (13-page-patterns, 16-platform) still cite nginx/nginx.conf for error pages and frame headers.

debt.title: Work-queue tracker uses its own hex palette
debt.detail: plan/work-queue-2026-10-30/tracker.html defines --bg:#f6f5f9 etc. instead of design-system tokens, against CLAUDE.md §4.

debt.title: registry.test seeds 'sn-saved-sets' but code reads 'sn-music-library-sets'

debt.detail: sn-set-draft and sn-music-library-sets are written by Library and Set builder without storage-event listeners; two tabs overwrite each other’s draft (last write wins).

gaps.title: README contract names a songnodes script that no longer exists
gaps.detail: README and .gitignore say scripts/sync-music-library.sh copies library.json to frontend/public/data/music-library.json. That script and folder are gone; songnodes now loads /api/v1/library/search fed by POST /api/v1/library/ingest (import-music-library.sh, and cmd_sync_songnodes inside cmd_db).

gaps.title: Saved-set shape is no longer shared between the two Set Builders
gaps.detail: musicLibrary sets carry tidal, shape, minutes, mix, pool, seed and ledger track ids (h:/bp:). songnodes stores only name, description and uuid track ids server-side and has no tidal flag. A songnodes 'Export sets for the weekly run' file imports into sets/set_tracks with uuid ids that match no ledger track, and sync-sets skips every set (no tidal). /api/v1/library/sets/export returns {sets:[...]} without ids, which load_sets turns into a list of lists and crashes on.

gaps.title: JohnCourse.json and kiki.json are written but never consumed
gaps.detail: Both are songnodes.setlists.v1 DJ tracklists (29 and 5 sets) at the musicLibrary root. cmd_sync_songnodes globs only the parent folder and inbox/, so they are never found; if found, the body {schema, setlists} does not match TracklistImportRequest {tracks, dj_artist, name} and the 422 is swallowed. JohnCourse.json.bak is invalid JSON.
gaps.fix: Move them to inbox/setlists/; post one request per setlist as {name: event, dj_artist: dj, tracks:[{artist,title,position,...}]}; log failures to outputs/<date>/ALERT_songnodes.txt.

gaps.title: Rekordbox play history and overrides do not feed back automatically
gaps.detail: Play history reaches only calibrate.py, and only from a hand-dropped overrides/rekordbox_collection.xml (absent); calibrate writes suggestions only and has never run. local_path must be typed into overrides, so the XML export holds 0 tracks and the buy list never shrinks.

gaps.title: songnodes proven transitions never inform musicLibrary set building
gaps.detail: Direction musicLibrary -> songnodes exists (library.json ingest; load-library-targets.sql makes library tracks scrape targets). Nothing flows back: library.json and the artifact Set Builder have no transition data, and the songnodes /sets page does not call the graph either.
gaps.fix: Add GET /api/v1/library/transitions?ids=… returning occurrence_count for library-track pairs; have build_db fetch it (optional) and add 'nx' (proven next track ids with counts) to library.json tracks; Set Builder ranks spares by it.

gaps.title: Second-source BPM and key are discarded
gaps.detail: When the chosen version is TIDAL, Deezer's BPM is used only for the cross-check; ref_mb is not queried by the pipeline at all despite the 2026-10-25 decision to cut web calls with it.
gaps.fix: In process, when v.bpm is null take the Deezer twin's bpm (fold to pillar range) and record bpm_source; add an optional ref_mb lookup by ISRC for key/label/release date.

gaps.title: Outputs with no reader
gaps.detail: outputs/crates/*.csv, rejected.csv, ledger/history/*, db/dj_library.sqlite (only DB Browser), tests/reports/* (songnodes output) and the review_queue override column have no code reader; ledger beatport_check (243) is read only by the supervised Beatport playbook, which has never run.
gaps.fix: Either delete the step or give it a consumer: have process read the newest review_queue.csv override column into energy_overrides; move tests/reports to songnodes.

gaps.title: TIDAL login collides with songnodes on 127.0.0.1:3006
gaps.detail: Both use the same TIDAL app and redirect; songnodes' /oauth/callback route consumes the single-use code if the frontend is up. Two TIDAL send paths exist (sync-sets 'SET · name' and songnodes /api/v1/tidal/sets/send) with separate token stores and no shared playlist map.
gaps.fix: Register a second redirect (http://127.0.0.1:3016/oauth/callback) on the TIDAL app for musicLibrary, or reuse songnodes' stored token through an endpoint; keep one playlist map keyed by set id.

gaps.title: songnodes drops pipeline fields on ingest
gaps.detail: library_search returns bp NULL, generated null, empty sources and runs, ids as uuids; rev/ovr/local/sync come back only if mapped. The songnodes Library page therefore cannot show buy links or run history that the artifact shows.
gaps.fix: Persist export extras (bp, sync, rev, ovr, local) from _from_export 'export' into evidence and select them in library_search; return generated and runs from library.runs.

gaps.title: Scraper must stop at bronze
gaps.detail: The unified scraper writes silver directly (layer skip, Unknown Artist, no outbox).
gaps.fix: Remove the tracks/playlists/playlist_tracks/song_adjacency branches from PersistencePipeline._flush_batch (keep bronze_* only) and rely on the ingest_pending follow-up; add a unique index on silver_enriched_tracks (bronze_id) or (lower(artist_name), lower(track_title)) and convert upsert_track to ON CONFLICT.
gaps.contract: Scraper output = bronze_scraped_playlists + bronze_scraped_tracks with positions 1..n; silver is written only by common/datalayer/ingest.py inside a transaction that appends an outbox event.

gaps.title: Target scrapes must bypass the daily discovery quota
gaps.detail: 1001tracklists targeted searches are blocked by scraped:setlists:1001tracklists:last_run.
gaps.fix: Set self.force_run = True in OneThousandOneTracklistsSpider.__init__ when search_query is given (as MixesDB does at line 116), or have the handler pass force_run=1 via params; and only stamp last_searched / found_nothing when the spider did not close with daily_quota_reached (return a reason from /scrape).
gaps.contract: POST /scrape response gains close_reason; handler treats daily_quota_reached as RetryableError.

gaps.title: Run the scrape HTTP call outside the job transaction
gaps.detail: A 16-minute open transaction holds xmin and stalls the outbox.
gaps.fix: In runner.run_one, let handlers declare long_io=True; for scrape, perform the HTTP POST before opening conn.transaction(), then record_playlists_found + follow-ups + complete inside a short transaction; lease (1800s) still guards double-run.
gaps.contract: Handler contract: (prepare outside tx) -> (commit inside tx).

gaps.title: Decide and document the real layer model
gaps.detail: Gold/operational exist only in docs and unused Helm cronjobs.
gaps.fix: Either (a) update CLAUDE.md to Bronze -> Silver -> projection_tracks/graph reads, drop gold_track_graph, or (b) add a gold job kind (REFRESH MATERIALIZED VIEW CONCURRENTLY gold_track_graph after ingest, apply medallion 008) and point graph-api at it. Record the choice in docs/decisions.
gaps.contract: Layer contract table: layer -> table -> sole writer -> readers.

gaps.title: Make API token usable by scripts and TIDAL routes
gaps.detail: Token middleware collides with TIDAL Bearer; import script sends no token; prefix typo. Queued PRs #578/#579 add a separate user login (cookie) but no enforcement on existing routes.
gaps.fix: In security/auth.py prefer X-API-Token over Authorization, fix the prefix to /api/v1/api-keys and add /api/v1/music-auth/spotify/token/status; pass SONGNODES_API_TOKEN and API_KEY_ENCRYPTION_SECRET through compose.dev.yaml; add -H "X-API-Token: $SONGNODES_API_TOKEN" to import-music-library.sh curl calls.
gaps.contract: X-API-Token header is the only admin credential; Authorization is reserved for provider tokens.

gaps.title: Project library_track events into projection_tracks
gaps.detail: Library search reads stale rows after a library ingest.
gaps.fix: In projection.handle_event treat aggregate_type library_track like track (project_track on aggregate_id), and add a consumer or explicit ignore list for library_set and setlist events.
gaps.contract: Outbox event registry: event_type -> consumers (projection_tracks, graph_projection).

gaps.title: Working backup for the compose volume
gaps.detail: No script backs up songnodes-dev_dev-postgres-18.
gaps.fix: Rewrite scripts/backup_database.sh to docker compose -f compose.dev.yaml exec -T postgres pg_dump -U songnodes -Fc songnodes > backups/songnodes-$(date +%Y%m%d).dump with retention, and retire backup_volumes.sh.

gaps.title: Single migration runner with a ledger
gaps.detail: Migrations are a hand list in start-dev.sh.
gaps.fix: Apply 000_schema_migrations_up.sql and extend services/worker/migrate.py to apply every sql/migrations/*_up.sql in numeric order once, recording filename+checksum; start-dev.sh calls docker compose run --rm worker python migrate.py.

gaps.title: Enforce the library ingest body contract
gaps.detail: Same key + different body silently returns the old job.
gaps.fix: Store sha256 of the canonical JSON payload in ingestion_jobs.payload_hash (or compare payload) in jobs.enqueue for library_ingest and raise CatalogError(409) on mismatch.

gaps.title: Music search has no deployed backend
gaps.detail: rest-api proxies to metadata-enrichment:8086, not in compose.
gaps.fix: Move the S1 search router into rest-api using common/providers (tidal, deezer) or add metadata-enrichment to compose; until then return an explicit 503 with cause in the UI.

gaps.title: Frontend calls routes that do not exist
gaps.detail: DJInterface posts /api/v1/scrapers/target-tracks/search and /api/v1/scrapers/queue/clear.
gaps.fix: Point DJInterface at POST /api/v1/target-tracks/{id}/search and drop queue/clear (no queue endpoint), or add the routes in a router module.

gaps.title: OAuth tokens written to sessionStorage have no reader
gaps.detail: Settings connects in the same window (window.location.href), so OAuthCallback has no opener: it writes sessionStorage <service>_oauth_tokens and redirects to /. GraphPage and SettingsPanel only read localStorage tidal_oauth_tokens/spotify_oauth_tokens (which OAuthCallback removes), so the browser store never receives the tokens; sendToTidal and useTokenRefresh then lack an access token.

gaps.contract: oauth-handoff/v1: {service, access_token, refresh_token, expires_at} consumed exactly once by the credentials slice

gaps.title: Graph page calls scraper endpoints that do not exist
gaps.detail: DJInterface posts to /api/v1/scrapers/target-tracks/search and /api/v1/scrapers/queue/clear; no rest-api route matches (route scan of services/rest_api).
gaps.fix: Point the actions at POST /api/v1/target-tracks/{id}/search and POST /api/v1/scrape/trigger, or remove the buttons; add a contract test listing every frontend path against the FastAPI OpenAPI document.

gaps.title: No IndexedDB last-good-data cache despite design-system rule
gaps.detail: design-system/16-platform.md:50 says SongNodes keeps the last graph, library and saved sets in IndexedDB and shows them with FreshnessStamp when the API is unreachable. No indexedDB usage exists in frontend/src; library load just errors and Home shows a dash.
gaps.fix: Add frontend/src/lib/offlineCache.ts (idb-keyval style store "sn-cache" with keys graph, library, sets, each {data, fetchedAt}); write on successful loadLibrary/useDataLoader/readSavedSetsAsync, read on failure and pass fetchedAt to FreshnessStamp.

gaps.title: artifact_sets.json lacks the tidal flag musicLibrary needs
gaps.detail: Set builder exports SavedSet[] without a 'tidal' field; musicLibrary run_weekly.py sync-sets filters sets by s.get('tidal'), so sets exported from songnodes are never pushed to TIDAL by the weekly run (songnodes has its own Send to TIDAL instead). The file is also only a browser download that has to be copied by hand.
gaps.fix: Either add 'tidal: boolean' (set when Send to TIDAL is requested) to SavedSet and the export, or document that songnodes sets go to TIDAL through /api/v1/tidal/sets/send and drop the inbox path; better, have musicLibrary read GET /api/v1/library/sets/export (exists, unused by the frontend).

gaps.title: Pending target syncs are never retried and override the server
gaps.detail: A failed POST/DELETE leaves pendingSync=true in sn-target-tracks-v1; nothing reads pendingSync, and useUnifiedTracks prefers the local entry over backend state, so the device can disagree with target_tracks forever.
gaps.fix: On useUnifiedTracks.refresh(), replay entries with pendingSync=true through syncTargetTrack, and drop local entries whose backend match agrees; show a count of unsynced targets.

gaps.title: Library freshness stamp is always unknown
gaps.detail: loadLibrary sets generated: null and runs: [] because /api/v1/library/search returns rows only; Home and Library show an en dash for 'Library data from' and the weekly-run launcher summary never appears.

gaps.title: Graph WebSocket has a server but no client
gaps.detail: graph-api exposes WEBSOCKET /api/graph/ws/{room_id} (nginx passes Upgrade headers for /api/graph). The only frontend WebSocket client (LiveDataLoader, /api/ws) is unreachable and targets a path rest-api does not serve.
gaps.fix: Delete LiveDataLoader/useLiveDataLoader, or rewire it to /api/graph/ws/<room> and mount it from GraphPage.

gaps.title: Library ingest allows 50 MB but frontend nginx accepts 1 MB
gaps.detail: LibraryImportDialog FileDrop limit is 50 MB and the body is the whole export; the frontend image nginx config sets no client_max_body_size, so nginx default 1 MB returns 413 for any larger export. STATUS.md already lists it as a follow-up.

holds: songnodes is Git-first with one integration branch, a scope guard and design-system CI; the frontend copy of the design system is in sync and its checkers report zero findings.
The scraping core is one unified-scraper container with complete-playlist rules, idempotency keys on ingest jobs and FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED job claiming.
musicLibrary's weekly run is a clear eight-step file pipeline with an append-only ledger, a resumable resolve step and a full SQLite rebuild every run.
Both projects already share one design system, one TIDAL developer app and one saved-set idea, so the join points are few and nameable.
strains: Contracts between the two projects have drifted: the documented sync script and file do not exist, and the two Set Builders no longer share a saved-set shape.
The medallion model in CLAUDE.md is not what runs: the scraper writes silver directly and no gold or operational job runs in compose.
Feedback loops are missing: play history, overrides and proven transitions never flow back into curation or set building, and no track has a BPM or key yet.
Security posture is not ready for the queued tunnel: write and admin routes are open and the queued login falls back to a default account.
summary.loop: The estate serves one loop: radio plays and DJ tracklists come in, become a curated club library, feed set building and the graph of proven transitions, play out in TIDAL and Rekordbox, and should come back as play history and corrections. Today the loop is open at the last step.

standing_rules.text: The NavDrawer is the only site navigation.
Never alert, confirm or prompt; use ConfirmDialog and Toast.
Tokens and sn-* classes only: no hex, rgb, named colours, px font sizes, ad-hoc radii, shadows or z-index numbers.
No emoji in the interface; en-AU sentence case; missing values are an en dash.
Pages register their route (G2) and REST routers register themselves (G3); do not wire App.tsx or main.py.
unified-scraper is the only scraper container.
Valid artists on both endpoints of every transition; no NULL or Unknown Artist in the graph.

modules.name: Set exchange
modules.inputs: songnodes saved sets (/api/v1/library/sets/export), artifact sets (artifact db `sets`)
modules.operation: Reads either saved-set shape and writes one versioned `songnodes.saved-set/2` document (name, shape, minutes, tracks[{isrc, tidal_id, ledger_id, tgt}], tidal) to musicLibrary inbox/artifact_sets.json, rejecting rows it cannot map.

modules.name: Play-history import
modules.inputs: Rekordbox / Lexicon collection XML, play counts and dates
modules.operation: Matches plays to ledger tracks by local_path then ISRC, appends `play` events to the ledger and writes rotation evidence that calibrate.py reads.

modules.name: Transition feed
modules.inputs: songnodes silver_track_transitions (occurrence_count) joined to library tracks
modules.operation: Publishes `songnodes.transitions/1` (pairs of ISRCs with counts) beside library.json so both Set Builders can rank spares by proven pairings.

modules.name: Contract check
modules.inputs: contracts/*.schema.json, the newest musicLibrary outputs, the songnodes ingest fixture
modules.operation: Validates every cross-project file and request body against its schema in CI and in the weekly run, and fails with the field that broke.

modules.name: Run monitor
modules.inputs: musicLibrary runs table and scrape_log; songnodes ingestion_jobs and web_call_log
modules.operation: Compares each run's resolve yield, source counts and job failures with the last four runs and raises one Banner-shaped warning with a source link when a figure drops by half.

backbone.summary: Keep each project's own data folder and owner. Add one shared contracts folder and one exchange folder with versioned, schema-checked files, so every cross-project hop is a named file or endpoint with one writer.

ux_proposals.title: Review queue
ux_proposals.pattern: LogPage (filter chips, selectable DataTable with bulk actions, entry panel) with inline NumberField and SelectField cells
ux_proposals.problem: The curator's weekly review is a CSV round trip: review_queue.csv lists all 413 tracks because none has a BPM, its override column is read by no code, and rows must be copied by hand into overrides/energy_overrides.csv with different columns. 0 overrides exist after four runs.
ux_proposals.proposal: A page that lists tracks needing a check (energy estimate, missing key or BPM, duplicate), lets the curator set energy, pillar, rotation and local_path in the row, and writes the override through the library API; the weekly run reads overrides from the API instead of the CSV. NavDrawer badge on Library shows the queue size; a warn Banner on /library links to it (every warning says where to fix it).
rules: design-system 07 warnings link to their source
ux_proposals.verify: Set energy on one queued track in the page; the next weekly run's ledger shows the override and the review queue shrinks by one.

ux_proposals.title: Track detail
ux_proposals.pattern: TrackDetailPage (KeyValueGrid, KeyBadge with key name, BpmReadout, EnergyBar, SourceBadge, Tabs: overview, plays, transitions)
ux_proposals.problem: Track detail is a modal (TrackDetailsModal) opened from the graph; the design system specifies a page, and nothing links a track to where it was heard, its proven transitions and its IDs in one place. The DJ's third step (key and mood) and the planner's spare suggestions have no fallback once the modal closes.
ux_proposals.proposal: Build the TrackDetailPage route; TrackCell titles in the crate, running order, graph side panel and review queue link to it; the transitions tab reads the transition feed (module M3) so the two projects share one view of a track.
ux_proposals.verify: Open a track from /library and from the graph; both land on /tracks/:id with key, BPM, energy, sources and transitions filled or shown as en dashes.

ux_proposals.title: Pipeline health
ux_proposals.pattern: MonitoringPage (one Banner, ConnectionStatus, four FigureTiles, ServiceStatus list with only problems expanded) plus a LogPage for run history with StagedProgress per run
ux_proposals.problem: The existing /pipeline is a telemetry page (queue a scrape, recent runs); nothing answers 'is anything broken'. The resolve yield fell from 614 of 777 to 6 of 81 with no alert, the weekly schedule drifted off Sunday 07:37, songnodes ingest failures are printed as a note, and the backup scripts back up nothing.
ux_proposals.proposal: Replace the telemetry page's head with the MonitoringPage pattern: a single Banner that names the worst current condition with a source link, FigureTiles for last run, resolve yield, review queue and last backup, and a run history page fed by module M5 (Run monitor). The existing scrape controls move under a 'Queue a scrape' Disclosure.
ux_proposals.verify: With a run whose yield is half the previous four, /pipeline opens on a warn Banner naming the run and linking to /pipeline/runs.

ux_proposals.title: Buy list
ux_proposals.pattern: LogPage with FilterChip (store, rotation), DataTable (TrackCell, price and store columns, Beatport check state as StatusPill) and bulk 'Mark bought'
ux_proposals.problem: Buying is a CSV (buy_list.csv) and a Beatport sync that has never run: 243 beatport_check songs are waiting and 0 tracks have a Beatport id. Bought tracks only reach Rekordbox when a local_path is typed into the overrides CSV.
ux_proposals.proposal: One page for High and Standard rotation tracks not yet owned, with the Beatport check state, a 'Mark bought' action that records the local_path (or a FileDrop of the file) and feeds the Rekordbox XML, and the assisted Beatport sync as a StagedProgress job started from the page.
ux_proposals.verify: Mark one track bought with a local file; the next run's rekordbox_musicLibrary.xml contains it and the buy list no longer does.

ux_proposals.title: One Set builder
ux_proposals.pattern: SetBuilderPage as built in songnodes; RetiredPageNotice for artifact/index.html and artifact/build/index.html; SetCard 'Send to TIDAL' state
ux_proposals.problem: Two Set Builders save sets in different shapes, each with its own Send to TIDAL, so one set can become two TIDAL playlists and a set saved in the artifact waits up to a week. The legacy artifact page breaks R1, R4 and R5 (43 linter findings).
ux_proposals.proposal: songnodes /sets becomes the only builder. The artifact pages show RetiredPageNotice with a link to /sets. Sending to TIDAL is one action with one state on the SetCard (queued for the weekly run, or sent now), backed by the set exchange (module M1) so the weekly run and the page agree.
ux_proposals.verify: Save a set on /sets and tick Send to TIDAL; exactly one 'SET · name' playlist exists after the next run, and the artifact URL shows the retired notice.

ux_proposals.title: Work queue on the design system
ux_proposals.pattern: LogPage (filter chips by wave and status, DataTable with CopyButton per prompt)
ux_proposals.problem: The developer's work-queue tracker defines its own colours (12 hex literals, !important) and so breaks R4 on the one page developers open most.
ux_proposals.proposal: Rebuild the tracker from the design system's LogPage pattern with its tokens inlined the way the report and reference.standalone.html are built, so it reads like every other page and the linter passes.
ux_proposals.verify: design-system/linters/check.py reports 0 findings on the tracker.

ux_proposals.title: One primary action when an empty state carries it
ux_proposals.problem: Three production pages show two primary buttons at once (Set builder, Pathfinder, Sources import) because the PageHeader primary and the EmptyState primary are both specified and the repo checker does not test the combination.
ux_proposals.proposal: Add the rule: while a page's EmptyState shows the primary action, the PageHeader primary is not rendered (the EmptyState is the view). Add it to rules/rules.yaml (INT family) and to scripts/check_design_system.py as a DOM check on the previews; record the decision in 17-governance.
ux_proposals.verify: The check fails on today's Set builder and passes once its header primary is hidden while the draft is empty.

ux_proposals.title: Linter catches 'Unknown' and Title Case labels
ux_proposals.problem: Five pages print 'Unknown algorithm', 'Unknown error', 'Unknown DJ' or Title Case button labels ('Copy Prompt', 'Run Search'); the linter's DATA-NULL rule only catches N/A, null, undefined and NaN, so the repo checker passes them.
ux_proposals.proposal: Extend DATA-NULL to the word Unknown (and 'Unknown …') in visible copy, and add WRT-CASE: a button or tab label of two or more capitalised words. Both run in the design-system workflow on the frontend's rendered previews, not only on static files.
ux_proposals.verify: check.py reports the five known sites; after the copy fixes it reports 0.

ux_proposals.title: Inline editable cell for DataTable
ux_proposals.pattern: DataTable `__edit` cell: NumberField or SelectField shown on Enter or click, saved on blur, with an InlineMessage on failure
ux_proposals.problem: The review queue (UX-01) and the buy list (UX-04) need a value set in the row; the design system has NumberField and SelectField but no rule for editing inside a table, so each page would invent one.
ux_proposals.proposal: Specify the editable cell once: which cells may be edited, the keyboard model (Enter edits, Esc cancels, Tab moves on), how a save failure is shown, and the print form (the value only). Add the card and a preview; bump the design system a minor.
ux_proposals.verify: The DataTable preview shows an editable energy cell that passes the design-system linter and the keyboard check.

ux_proposals.title: Freshness on every data page
ux_proposals.pattern: FreshnessStamp sourced from the server, IndexedDB last-good cache as 16 platform already specifies
ux_proposals.problem: The library's freshness stamp is always unknown (library.generated is never set), the IndexedDB last-good-data cache that 16 platform requires does not exist, and polling backoff never engages, so a reader cannot tell live data from stale.
ux_proposals.proposal: Make the stamp a page-pattern requirement: every data page's PageHeader shows 'Data from <stamp>' from the ingest or run time, goes amber past the module's staleness threshold and links to Pipeline health (UX-03). Add a conformance check that a data page without a stamp fails. The cache stays a frontend task (SN-T10).
ux_proposals.verify: /library shows the last ingest time; after the threshold the stamp turns warn and its link opens /pipeline.

ux_proposals.title: Service rows tell the truth about OAuth
ux_proposals.pattern: AuthCallbackPage (progress, then connected or what went wrong) and ServiceStatus with the one fixing action
ux_proposals.problem: Settings redirects in the same window, the callback writes sessionStorage keys nothing reads, and the readers look for localStorage keys the callback deletes; Send to TIDAL then fails with a token error while Settings may still look connected. A TIDAL login for the weekly run also collides with songnodes on port 3006.
ux_proposals.proposal: Specify that ServiceStatus derives its state from a token the app can actually use (a probe call), never from the presence of a key; the callback page always lands on a connected or failed state with 'Reconnect' as the one action; Settings shows a notice when the musicLibrary login needs port 3006. The token hand-off itself is task SN-T09.
ux_proposals.verify: After a fresh TIDAL login the Services row reads Connected and Send to TIDAL succeeds; after revoking the token the row reads Reconnect within one probe.
